prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production Unity 2.5D game enemy animation sprite sheet. Input image is ONLY the identity/silhouette and exact VIEW direction reference. Redraw this same Swarmer, not a new creature. Materials: matte dark rock brown armor, warm gray-white sinewy limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style matching AlienPurge. Camera fixed elevated 45 degrees, soft upper-left light. Very low, flat, small quadruped scout with one broad smooth wedge-shaped brown rocky carapace covering its back, small pointed front head with a narrow amber eye slit, pale gray tendon limbs splayed laterally, FOUR limbs only. No dorsal organs, no horns, no tall ridges. Keep the low turtle/beetle silhouette of the reference.
CRITICAL DIRECTION: RIGHT profile facing screen right, nose at right edge of body and tail at left; keep this exact direction in EVERY pose, no turns.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR columns and 4 rows, 16 separate full character drawings. Square canvas, each equal square cell contains one complete creature within its central 70%, generous fully transparent gutters all around. No silhouettes touch, no cropped feet, no detached bits. Read frames left to right then top to bottom. Rows1-2: EIGHT distinct sequential WALK frames, alternating diagonal foot pairs lift and plant with a continuous scuttling gait, torso stays nearly level. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breathing poses, planted feet, subtle living tissues, no whole-body scaling. Row4: FOUR distinct DEATH poses: legs progressively buckle, carapace settles onto floor, head rests, eye goes dark; a quiet non-explosive collapse.
Every frame holds the EXACT SAME camera direction, identity, proportions, four legs and plate count. Real joint motion, no duplicate frames or whole-body-only transforms. Anchor feet at the same baseline and body at same center in each cell. Empty pixels true alpha 0, including holes between legs; no solid background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text/labels/grid, no VFX/projectiles. Render clean silhouette edges.
